Need dimensions reserved before load (e.g. build-time width/height or aspect-ratio via per-image data, or placeholder min-height).

attempts.note: Real print output (headless Chrome --print-to-pdf of /blog/pi-bench-harness-iterations/, 13 pages): masthead/TOC/share/comments/related/sidebar hidden, URLs appended, no horizontal overflow (max x 578 < 612pt). BUT the post-header hero overlay is not neutralized: page 1 prints the dark overlay_image banner with the title, meta and lead in WHITE text on top of it, and then the lead paragraph is duplicated below. Fix: in @media print force .page__hero, .page__hero--overlay and their title/meta/lead to background:none, color:#000, padding small, and drop the lead duplicate or hero image.
